name: SDF Prb Reparam Integrator
definition: A differentiable path tracer that uses reparameterization to compute gradients of radiance with respect to scene parameters (e.g., SDF shape parameters) by warping random samples, supporting both forward and backward mode automatic differentiation.
summary: SDF Prb Reparam Integrator is a differentiable path tracer that computes radiance gradients with respect to SDF parameters by warping random samples via reparameterization.
